text.text: The Neo Geo Pocket was released in 1998 as SNK's first dedicated handheld gaming system. Designed to compete with Nintendo's Game Boy line, the system featured a monochrome display, a unique click-style joystick, and a focus on arcade-style games. Its library included titles based on SNK franchises such as King of Fighters R-1, Samurai Shodown, Metal Slug, and Neo Turf Masters. The system was later replaced by the color Neo Geo Pocket Color, which maintained compatibility with most original games. Although it had a short lifespan, the Neo Geo Pocket established SNK's presence in handheld gaming and developed a dedicated following among arcade fans.
